digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend test suite
propositions: DC backend lacks value-pinning unit tests; only shape assertions exist in test_backend_contract.py while Cloud's test_backend_characterization.py pins hardened production values
The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised only through AdfCodec, leaving WikiTextCodec composition path untested for DC
DC's _map_local_to_dc_fields create-path mapper requires pinning of every key emission (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee) including default-fallback branches
DC sanitizer boundaries for summary, description and comment must be pinned at-limit and one-over with exact truncation suffix marker
DC probe branch classification must reach all four branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) through real classifier, not FakeTransport stub
DC must prove it binds its own resolved_statuses config rather than Cloud's hardcoded set, distinguishable only via non-default custom status set
